timeline.summary: IndoStar Capital Finance allotted 60,000 NCDs aggregating ₹600 Cr on private placement.
SEBI cancelled the registration of IndoStar Credit Fund, an inoperative Category II AIF subsidiary, with no financial impact or penalty.
IndoStar Capital Finance amended its Code of Fair Disclosure under SEBI PIT Regulations on May 27, 2026.
Shikha Jain (Membership No. A59686) posted the audio recording of the conference call on audited FY2026 results on May 28, 2026, available at **indostarcapital.com/audio-or-video-recordings**.
IndoStar Capital Finance held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 28, 2026, outlining a strategic 3-year growth framework through FY29.
IndoStar Capital presented its Q2FY27 investor update highlighting 70% scorecard target by Mar-27 and AUM of ₹8,459 Cr.
Audio recording of the Conference Call on Unaudited Financial Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is available on the company website, effective October 30, 2026.
